## Round 1 Strategy (Team: advertiser_1 & advertiser_2)

**Our coordinated plan:**

- **advertiser_1** (value 5.07/click): Focus on the highest-value slot (Slot 1, 50 clicks). We'll bid moderately high (e.g., 4.00) to secure it comfortably.
- **me** (value 3.34/click): Focus on the remaining slots (Slot 2: 30 clicks, Slot 3: 10 clicks). We'll bid just above our value to win these smaller slots, capturing additional profit.

**Why this works:**
- advertiser_1 has a significantly higher value (5.07 vs 3.34), so they should dominate the big slot (Slot 1).
- By letting them take Slot 1, we preserve our budget for the smaller, lower-value slots where our combined effort can still yield profit.
- In Slot 1, advertiser_1 will pay the second-highest bid (which will be our bid) per click. Since we're the only other bidder, we pay our own bid amount. By bidding just above our value (e.g., 3.34 → 3.35), we minimize our cost while ensuring we win.
- In Slots 2 and 3, we bid competitively to win them outright, paying the reserve price (1) per click if needed, but our value (3.34) exceeds the reserve, so we profit on those clicks.

This maximizes our combined total profit across the round.
